A first frame announcing more than 520 bytes is answered with FC OVFLW." style="text;html=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#333333;spacingLeft=0;spacingTop=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="440" width="740" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.text: not running: the block is complete
Both timers start when the frame is handed to the CAN controller: the link sees no transmit confirmation.
N_Cr stops once a block is complete and starts again when the next CTS is handed over.
FC WAIT restarts N_Bs, at most 16 in a row (WFTmax); FC OVFLW or an undefined flow status ends the transfer at once.
While consecutive frames are leaving, N_Bs also bounds a transmit FIFO that stays full; each CF refreshes it.
A first frame announcing more than 520 bytes is answered with FC OVFLW.
